The '''EW-39 War Droid''', also known as the '''AC-MKII Droid''', was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model used for security by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The droid moved on three legs and had its armaments inside the upper appendages.
